mechanism: Chlorpromazine lowers seizure threshold while piperacillin-tazobactam can cause neurotoxicity and seizures, creating additive CNS risk; additionally, chlorpromazine may have minor hepatic metabolism interactions.
action: Monitor closely for seizure activity and neurotoxic symptoms; consider alternative antibiotics if seizure history present; ensure appropriate dosing of piperacillin-tazobactam for renal function.
